meta.description: Unified prompt templates for product content generation

persona.name: starstuck_lab_voice
persona.description: Core brand voice: poetic, melancholic, technically precise with dry humor

product_excerpt.prompt:
Generate a compelling one-sentence excerpt (max 20 words) for "{title}"{category_clause}.

The excerpt should be:
- Poetic and intriguing
- Slightly melancholic with dry humor
- Evocative of cosmic existentialism
- Technical yet elegant

Return ONLY the excerpt, nothing else.

product_tagline.prompt:
Generate a short, catchy tagline (max 12 words) for "{title}"{category_clause}.

The tagline should be:
- Memorable and punchy
- Poetic with dry humor
- Slightly melancholic
- Technical yet accessible

Return ONLY the tagline, nothing else.

product_description.description: Rich, detailed product description in markdown
product_description.prompt:
Write a rich, detailed {word_count} word product description in Markdown format for "{title}"{category_clause}.

{excerpt_clause}{features_clause}{specs_clause}
Structure the description with:
- A compelling opening paragraph (2-3 sentences) that sets the tone
- Multiple detailed paragraphs covering features and benefits
- Use **bold** for emphasis on key terms
- Use *italic* for poetic flourishes
- Include ## subheadings to organize sections
- Weave in technical specifications naturally throughout

Writing style:
- Poetic and evocative with dry humor
- Technically accurate but accessible and engaging
- Slightly melancholic with cosmic existential undertones
- Include vivid metaphors and imagery
- Focus on the product's unique value and emotional resonance
- Make it feel like a story, not a spec sheet

Return ONLY the markdown-formatted description, ready to paste into a CMS.

product_image.prompt:
Professional product photography of "{title}", a {category}. {style_enhancement}

Style requirements:
- Warm Studio Ghibli-themed aesthetic
- Clean white background
- Technically accurate
- High resolution
- Professional product photography
- Studio Ghibli art style
- Warm lighting
- Magical realism
- Detailed craftsmanship

category_clause.logic: if category: return f', a {category}' else: return ''

excerpt_clause.logic: if excerpt: return f'Product Tagline/Excerpt: {excerpt}\n' else: return ''

features_clause.logic:
if features: return f'
Key Features:
' + '
'.join(f'- {f.title}: {f.description}' for f in features) else: return ''

specs_clause.logic:
if specs: return f'
Technical Specifications:
' + '
'.join(f'- {s.label}: {s.value}' for s in specs) else: return ''

description_clause.logic: if description: return f'\nDescription: {description}\n' else: return ''
